title: Kaftor VaFerach — complete source-faithful bilingual Reader audit

audit_scope.method: Every printed line on all nineteen source PDF pages was visually reviewed against the page facsimile. Each English unit was independently reviewed for complete one-to-one semantic correspondence, including continuations across page boundaries.

editorial_notes: Only printed captions were transcribed on photographic pages; no invented photo descriptions were added.
The unusual printed abbreviation הגד״צ on PDF page 14 is preserved rather than silently normalized.
Page-boundary continuations are retained as separate source-page units while their English remains grammatically continuous.
